offers.sn: 💙 Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We see a tremendous financial, social and environmental value in making sure unused items are put to use again.
offers.rq: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role within warehouse, logistics, or production Strong communication skills in both Polish and English
